name: Echoes of Aether - city landmarks & district buildings kit
generator: blender/city_landmarks (Blender 5.2 headless + numpy, fully procedural). Rebuild: see LANDMARKS.md

conventions.units: metres; FBX exported with apply_scale_options=FBX_SCALE_ALL, bake_space_transform=True, axis_forward=-Z, axis_up=Y -> import at scale 1, identity rotation
conventions.axes: Unity Y up, asset FRONT = +Z (Blender -Y). Prototype mapping: Unity = (-x, y, z); a yaw of 0 faces prototype +z (south).
conventions.pivot: base-centre of the building MASS for landmarks / buildings / plaza blocks; roof sets: base-centre on the roof slab; facade pieces ('wall-base'): centre of the bottom edge on the host wall plane, projecting toward +Z
conventions.lods: <Name>_LOD0/1/2 siblings -> LODGroup. LOD1 ~25-40% (openings with reveals, big props), LOD2 ~3-6% (flat walls + flush lit window panes so the night silhouette survives). lodTransitions: one value per LOD, last = cull (0 = never, the city culler handles it).
conventions.materials: Max 8 slots per asset: env-kit tiling materials + this kit's lm_* materials + the shared building atlases (building_trim_atlas, emit_building_atlas; defined in the Environment manifest) + env holo/glass.
conventions.uv0: metres for tiling materials (world-scale, explicit facade UVs: U along the wall, V = height); atlas faces use 0..1 atlas UVs.
conventions.colliders: box colliders in Unity local space (centre/size). Landmarks carry their own colliders; plaza blocks / kit buildings: the zone code keeps its mass collider, the manifest box is the mass.
conventions.textures: BaseColor sRGB, Normal OpenGL (Unity convention), MaskMap linear RGBA (R metallic, G AO, B height, A smoothness); Occlusion points at the MaskMap (URP samples .g).
